project_profile.title: Hybrid Tech Documentary Essay (Baikov x The 2030 Style)
project_profile.core_aesthetic: Reflective, analytical, high-stakes technological shift, warm analog-digital hybrid

vocal_prosody.pacing: Crisp, urgent, zero dead-air within phrases, 0.5s strict pause between sentences
vocal_prosody.timbre: Dry, close-mic, chest-dominant, zero smile resonance

music_bed.genre: Dark Minimalist Pulse / Deep Sub-Bass Drone
music_bed.characteristics: Rhythmic low-end pulse without distracting top-melody

act_1_hook_and_identity.sfx_palette: Warm analog camera clicks, subtle low-pass air whooshes, deep sub-bass thud on major frame cuts (Max 5 cues)

act_2_analytical_execution.reference_model: Hybrid Baikov UI Flow x Documentary Pacing

vocal_prosody.pacing: Measured, analytical, 15% slower cognitive rhythm via punctuation pauses (never time-stretch)
vocal_prosody.pitch_contour: Downward inflection at every clause end to convey factual weight
vocal_prosody.timbre: Warm baritone/alto, calm, contemplative, slight micro-hesitation before key technical terms

music_bed.genre: Minimalist Electronic Underscore / Warm Synth Plucks
music_bed.characteristics: Steady metronomic pulse, muted high frequencies (<4kHz dominant) to leave 100% vocal clarity

act_2_analytical_execution.sfx_palette: Soft glassmorphism UI taps (low-passed at 4.5kHz), dampened tactile mechanical switches, smooth filter sweeps (Max 6 cues)

act_3_philosophical_resolution.visual_context: Takes Our Place, Jensen Huang & Sam Altman Clips

vocal_prosody.pacing: Slow, weighty, deliberate. Mandatory 1.2s silence before and after archival English clips
vocal_prosody.pitch_contour: Deep downward cadence, solemn and philosophical
vocal_prosody.timbre: Deep chest resonance, intimate, serious documentary narrator

music_bed.genre: Cinematic Ambient Swell / Melancholic Analog Pads & Cello
music_bed.target_lufs: Complete drop (-inf LUFS) during first 2 seconds of archival clip, swelling back to -18.0 LUFS after speech
music_bed.characteristics: Emotional wide stereo field, slow attack, resonant reverb tail

act_3_philosophical_resolution.sfx_palette: Deep cinematic sub-drop at archival transition, subtle vinyl/tape floor noise, long dark reverb tail on final word (Max 4 cues)

mastering_and_engineering_constraints.vocal_eq_chain: High-pass @ 80Hz, Warmth boost +1.5dB @ 160Hz, Harshness cut -2.5dB high-shelf @ 7.5kHz
mastering_and_engineering_constraints.archival_clip_protection: Never trim within 0.3s of first/last spoken phoneme; preserve original playback_rate = 1.0

rejection_triggers: Narrator sounds upbeat, cheerful, commercial, or rises in pitch at the end of sentences.
Background music contains corporate guitar/ukulele, bright vocal chops, or trap hi-hats.
SFX sound literal, cartoonish, or occur more than once every 5 seconds.
Archival clips (Jensen/Sam Altman) are cut off mid-word or time-stretched.
Mix sounds flat/over-compressed without breathing room or silence before key transitions.
